# Copilot Instructions for Integral Education Platform

Always-on core guidance is intentionally lean for token cost control.

1. Read `AGENTS.md` first (repo root).
2. Treat `docs/quality/*`, `docs/maps/*`, and `docs/implementation/integral-aqal-protocol-template.md` as canonical standards.
3. Never claim therapy/clinical care, and escalate Tier 2/3 safety content to human review.
4. Run `npm run build` for docs/navigation changes before completion.
5. Load detailed guidance on demand from `.agents/skills/` (see AGENTS.md for the full index).
